emails.subject: Your Lesko Help account is ready and waiting for you
emails.preview_text: You haven't been inside yet. Your first sign-in takes about a minute.

emails.subject: Nobody sent you a password. You make your own
emails.preview_text: First a 6-digit code, then you pick your password. That's the part people miss.

emails.subject: We miss you, and your seat is still empty
emails.preview_text: Coaches answer questions all day long. None of them are yours yet.

emails.subject: The members finding grant money all did this one thing first
emails.preview_text: They're not smarter than you. They just opened the door.

emails.subject: I think you might be stuck. Let us help you in
emails.preview_text: Write to us and one of our team will do their best to get you in.
